abstract: We have studied the pharmacokinetics of single agent high dose cyclophosphamide (HDC) (160-240 mg kg-1) given as repeated intravenous (i.v.) infusions to six patients with small cell lung cancer (SCLC), and HDC (180 mg kg-1) combined with etoposide (750-1000 mg m-2) as repeated i.v. infusions to five patients with SCLC and two patients with teratoma. HDC has a similar pharmacokinetic profile to low dose cyclophosphamide, with a half-life of 4.83 +/- 1.3 h. Repeated administration of HDC produced a small but significant shortening of the half life (P = 0.02). The terminal half-life of high dose etoposide was 7.7 +/- 2 h which is similar to our previous results with low dose etoposide (50-300 mg m-2), but the volume of distribution which was 35.5 +/- 11.6 1. was significantly increased (P less than 0.001). Plasma steady state concentrations of 26.2 +/- 11.7 micrograms ml-1 were achieved. The possible mechanism for the alteration of volume of distribution of etoposide will be discussed.
abstract_ja: 小細胞肺癌(SCLC)の患者6例に対する単剤の大量シクロホスファミド(HDC)(160～240 mg/kg)の薬物動態、ならびに、SCLC患者5例と奇形腫患者2例に対するHDC(180 mg/kg)とエトポシド(750～1000 mg/m²)併用の薬物動態を、反復静脈内投与で検討した。HDCの薬物動態は低用量シクロホスファミドと類似しており、半減期は4.83±1.3時間であった。HDCの反復投与により半減期はわずかだが有意に短縮した(P=0.02)。大量エトポシドの終末半減期は7.7±2時間であり、これは低用量エトポシド(50～300 mg/m²)での既報の結果と類似していた。一方、分布容積は35.5±11.6 Lで有意に増加していた(P<0.001)。定常状態の血漿中濃度は26.2±11.7 μg/mlに達した。エトポシドの分布容積の変化の機序について考察する。
